title: Stasis Portal Fantasy
description: A surreal gothic scene features a woman in a black and pink Victorian dress holding a glowing pink orb while standing beside a man seated in a pink Radio Flyer wagon. Six small skeletons march in line across the foreground toward a large ornate golden frame containing a swirling orange vortex and floating angelic figures. A giant green praying mantis hovers near a dark castle in a swirling purple sky pierced by a pink energy beam from a circular portal.
